product_metadata.title: iTouchless 4 Gallon Bathroom Trash Can with AbsorbX Odor Filter and Air Freshener, Pearl Waste Bin for Restroom, Bedroom and Office, 4 Gal, White Sensor, MT04SW-7
features: OUR PROMISE TO YOU – Your 100% satisfaction is assured and backed by a Full-Service Manufacturer's Warranty and Dedicated Customer Support (see user manual for details)

EFFORTLESS and HYGIENIC - 100% Touchless Trash Can with Sensor-Operated Lid – no touching required, the motion sensor opens the lid automatically. Helps you avoid contact with the ilness-causing germs and bacteria in the restroom.
COMPLETE ODOR CONTROL – includes 1 AbsorbX Odor Filter and 1 Lemon-Scented Fragrance Cartridge, it’s the perfect trash can for controlling odors in the bathroom
BEAUTIFUL and DURABLE – Elegant matte white steel can body and high-quality, silver-colored ABS plastic lid, fingerprint-resistant and easy to clean

COMPACT SIZE PERFECT FOR THE BATHROOM – Space-saving design allows it to fit neatly next to the toilet or under the sink. Dimensions: 10.3 inch W x 6.95 inch L x 17.9 inch H (23.7 inch H with lid open)
RISK FREE - Manufacturer offers 1 Year Warranty. Fits standard size trash bags. No expensive custom bags required.
description: Convenient and hygienic, iTouchless Automatic Bathroom Garbage Bin is the easy and clean way to dispose of trash in the bathroom. Just move your hand toward the lid and the infrared motion sensor will open the lid automatically. The lid will close automatically when you are finished. It’s easy and hygienic!
